headline: PHP2Shell attacks on Check Point gateways drop TSGA backdoor and wipe ESXi files; N-central zero-day; SCKit hits MSPs

bullets.text: New: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-123039, 5 outlets) attacks on Check Point gateways now deploy a TSGA backdoor and wipe ESXi files, per The Hacker News. No fixed release is on the board.
New: Nightmare Eclipse has dropped SignDrop, a Windows zero-day exploit that abuses CLFS to gain SYSTEM privileges (SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, The Hacker News). No fix is on the board.

N-central (PoC, 6 outlets): the N-able '4EverAble2Shell' zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC; attackers infected 21 servers, 19 of them on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe. No CVE or fix is on the board.
MSPs (8 outlets): worm-like SCKit malware spreads through ScreenConnect support sessions, nearly 50 organizations report breaches, and ConnectWise has disabled third-party extensions.

Still active: 4,800 GitHub accounts compromised to steal cloud credentials; Apache httpd patched critical HTTP/2 RCE CVE-2026-119618; critical Xen Orchestra flaws exploited; critical Red Hat Quay flaw exposes private images. Also: Fireworks AI/Notion, Turla, Maersk.

KEV due today (11-13): Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. SITCON 3; the last 7 days run 1.09x the 90-day average.

actions: Check Point: limit gateway management to trusted networks, hunt for TSGA backdoor indicators, and back up ESXi hosts offline; await for a CVE-2026-123039 fix.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts, unexpected agent commands and implants.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, confirm third-party extensions are disabled, and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions.
Windows: watch for unexpected SYSTEM-level activity tied to CLFS and apply Microsoft's SignDrop fix as soon as one ships.
GitHub: review recent sign-ins, PATs and Actions secrets and rotate cloud credentials; patch Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618.
Patch Barracuda ESG today (KEV deadline 11-13) and restrict Xen Orchestra and Red Hat Quay to trusted networks until patched.
